sourceSufficiencyAssessment: The selected multi-timescale, contextual argument is supported by actual book passages, a complete official author talk and substantial interviews; lack of a complete EPUB is not a blocker. No wholesale reconstruction from blurbs found. Two retained details exceed the particular sources assigned to their screens, however. Both have now been verified in lawful primary material identified below. REQUIRES-FIXES is for repairing that exact evidence map and preserving honest source roles, not a finding that the ideas are false or that the whole edition is required. Other-chapter omissions do not materially reverse the bounded argument. The preserved cases and qualifications carry Sapolsky’s reasoning rather than a new managerial or moral lesson.
substantiveParityAssessment: All 22 pairs, metadata, source notes and method note read in both languages; no substantive RU/EN mismatch. The phone is hypothetical in both. Biology/learning and gene/environment are intertwined; the text asserts no single-region, hormone or gene determination, age-25 guarantee, treatment efficacy or intervention. The free-will/justice conclusion is explicitly Sapolsky’s position, not consensus. No contemporary scientific validation inferred from faithful recount.
